Game Overview

Ninja Jump is a ninja title where leap into the sky as a nimble ninja cube, avoiding spikes and collecting coins. Simple yet addictive, Ninja Jump challenges your reflexes with its vibrant, cartoony graphics. Unlock new levels and characters while striving to outdo your last score in this thrilling upward adventure. Play anywhere, anytime!
